text:
Two pieces of seasoned, pan-fried fish or tofu sit on a bed of mixed greens on a square plate. The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm.

Each piece is roughly 8 x 6 cm and about 2 cm thick, which is about 90 g each, so about 180 g of protein in total. If it is tofu or a firm white fish with a little oil, that comes to about 150-250 kcal.

The greens add about 60-80 g and roughly 20 kcal. A little dressing or oil adds about 40 kcal.

That gives about 260 g of food and about 280 kcal.
